title: Bposhtels Nashville - Mixed 4 Beds Shared
description:
1 Bed in a 4 Beds Mixed Shared Room. Prices Are Per Person.
Our Nashville Hostel is conveniently located among the main points of interest in the city! It has comfortable shared rooms and spacious common areas. A combination of Location, Amenities and Social you won’t find anywhere else!
Bposhtels Nashville is between the Airport and Downtown, next also to the Music Valley. It is convenient for transportation and near restaurants, bars, museums and entertainment!
Welcome to the Music City!

Other things to note
Check-in is after 3PM to 11PM | Check-out is by 11 AM. After hours check-in is also possible with our 24h desk.

Bposhtels only offer shared, not private rooms. Travelers Only. Please be aware we do not control other roommates immediate behavior. Quiet hours in the rooms are from 10 PM to 10 AM. VISITORS ARE NOT ALLOWED. YOU ARE ASKED TO STEP OUTSIDE THE ROOM DURING CLEANING. ALL YOUR BELONGINGS MUST BE STORED INSIDE YOUR BOX OR ON/UNDER YOUR BED NOT TO BE DISCARDED. We are not responsible for any belongings missing. Our shared rooms are for travelers only and any proof of traveling will be required to allow check-in.

It is included: Wi-Fi, Nearby Paid Parking, In-Room Personal Storage, Luggage and Package Storage (add 'Bposhtels' for package deliveries). Amenities fee is already included for daily bath essentials and daily towels. No smoking on the property.
